sponsored.t: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage, Nassau county, New York, Inc.; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; directs that certain taxes received shall be used by such benevolent association in furtherance of its purposes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Powell House, in the village of Farmingdale, county of Nassau, to apply for a retroactive property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Powell House, in the village of Farmingdale, county of Nassau, to apply for and receive a retroactive property tax exemption with respect to the 2024-2025 school tax assessment rolls and the 2025 general tax assessment roll.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Merrick Hook & Ladder Co. 1 fire company recieve retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Merrick Hook & Ladder Co. 1 fire company receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the property located at 1893 Oakwood Ave, hamlet of Merrick, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Police Officer Frederick G. Maley
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Police Officer Frederick G. Maley in the hamlet of North Bellmore, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. This act shall take effect immediately.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to William Cornell
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the Wantagh state parkway from route 27 to Jerusalem Road in the hamlet of Wantagh, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau to William Cornell.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney"
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney" in the town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

sponsored.t: Directs the director of the office of the aging to establish a caregiver crisis hotline
sponsored.sum: Directs the director of the office of the aging to establish a caregiver crisis hotline to provide emotional support resources for informal caregivers of a person in need of assistance.
sponsored.fis: To be determined, however, the program is expected to generate long-term savings by reducing hospitalizations and delaying nursing home place- ments.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward L. Cunningham"
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Nassau county to "Trooper Edward L. Cunningham".

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act" to provide additional credits to the Nassau county law enforcement explorers in competitive civil service examinations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Kenneth Panaro
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Kenneth Panaro.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Hempstead to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Telugu Literary and Cultural Association
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Telugu Literary and Cultural Association for the property located at 1 North Village Green, hamlet of Levittown, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Joshua Kaye to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Joshua Kaye to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption during any period of strike by an employee organization, work stoppage or declared state of emergency
sponsored.sum: Provides that no individual or entity shall be charged a central business district toll during any period of strike by an employee organization, work stoppage or declared state of emergency that causes a stoppage for more than twenty-four hours or significant delays of any metropolitan transportation authority, metro north commuter railroad, New York city transit authority, or Long Island railroad services.
sponsored.fis: Savings to commuters. Temporary unknown loss of revenue due to central business district tolls not being collected.

sponsored.t: Expands the amount of time a notice of defect must be kept
sponsored.sum: Expands the amount of time a notice of defect must be kept from five years to ten years.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a pedestrian bridge in the hamlet of Seaford to the victims of the Abbey Gate attack
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a pedestrian bridge in the hamlet of Seaford to the victims of the Abbey Gate attack located in the town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain lodging facilities from offering hourly rate options
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain lodging facilities from offering hourly rate options of less than six hours.

sponsored.t: Establishes the research literacy enhancement program and fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the research literacy enhancement program to make grants to academic institutions within the state which seek to conduct research on literacy; creates the research literacy enhancement fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits people from engaging in protest outside a place of religious worship
sponsored.sum: Prohibits people from engaging in protests outside a place of religious worship; establishes that protests must be a minimum of twenty-five feet away from a place of religious worship.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael Kilbride to reapply for an accidental disability retirement benefit
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael Kilbride to reapply for an accidental disability retirement benefit.

sponsored.t: Relates to interpersonal violence prevention classes in secondary high schools
sponsored.sum: Requires all secondary high schools to include the legal and social consequences of disseminating sexually explicit messages, imagery or video and cyberbullying in interpersonal violence prevention education in health classes.

sponsored.t: Provides five hundred employment slots for first responders who performed their duties in the area of the September eleventh, two thousand one terrorist attacks
sponsored.sum: Provides five hundred employment slots for first responders who performed their duties in the area of the September eleventh, two thousand one terrorist attacks in the weeks and months thereafter and suffered a service-related disability as a result of being exposed to toxins.

sponsored.t: Establishes a committee to examine the state industrial code and recommend any changes that need to be made
sponsored.sum: Establishes a committee to examine the state industrial code and recommend any changes that need to be made; requires a report to be sent to the governor, the commissioner, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the senate minority leader and assembly minority leader on any changes that need to be made to the state industrial code.

sponsored.t: Requires community service for graduation from high school
sponsored.sum: Requires a total of thirty-six hours, or eight hours per year, for a high school student to graduate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the location of fire hydrants
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of fire prevention and control to establish a state database of every fire hydrant latitude and longitude coordinates; requires every municipal corporation or private entity to provide such coordinates to the office.

sponsored.t: Enacts Alexa and Lindsey's law
sponsored.sum: Enacts Alexa and Lindsey's law; prohibits disabling safety features in motor vehicles; provides enhanced penalties where it causes an accident that harms or kills another person; provides that if multiple people are harmed or killed as a result of an unsafe vehicle modification a consecutive sentence may be imposed.

sponsored.t: Renames the Governor Mario M. Cuomo bridge the Lieutenant Michael P. Murphy Tappan Zee bridge
sponsored.sum: Renames the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge the Lieutenant Michael P. Murphy Tappan Zee Bridge; directs the commissioner of transportation to provide for the installation and maintenance of adequate signage of the state highway system.

sponsored.t: Exempts Wantagh school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts Wantagh union free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Al-Hikmah Institute Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Al-Hikmah Institute Inc.

sponsored.t: Enhances transparency in the prescription drug supply chain
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "foreign drug transparency act" to provide information on the origin, manufacture and distribution of prescription drugs; requires a pharmacy benefit manager to maintain, and make available to pharmacies, health plans, and patients upon request, supply chain information for prescription drugs covered under its network.

sponsored.t: Establishes a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for individuals in active military service of the United States and active duty members of the New York national guard
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the Long Island Rail Road, to establish a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for individuals in active military service of the United States and active duty members of the New York national guard, upon showing a military or national guard identification card.

sponsored.t: Relates to the procedure for voting increases in the rate of state taxes
sponsored.sum: Provides that no bill which increases, extends, imposes or revives any tax, fee, assessment, surcharge or any other such levy or collection, be passed or become a law, except by the assent of two-thirds of the members elected to each branch of the legislature voting separately; makes an exception for any bill which results from the passage of a home rule message.

sponsored.t: Requires government-issued photo registration for registration and voting
sponsored.sum: Requires a signature and government-issued photo identification for both voter registration and at the time of voting.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of grants under the volunteer fire infrastructure and response equipment (V-FIRE) grant program
sponsored.sum: Requires grants under the volunteer fire infrastructure and response equipment (V-FIRE) grant program to be awarded equally among the regions of the state with eligible departments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the personal income tax rates; repealer
sponsored.sum: Phases in tax cuts to the personal income tax over a period of ten years; repeals certain provisions relating to tax benefit recapture.
sponsored.fis: Tax cut of roughly $35 billion when fully implemented

sponsored.t: Relates to information relating to discharged New York state residents
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of veterans' services to obtain information from the United States department of veterans affairs related to the county of residence of New York state veterans discharged from active service, in which county such veterans reside, and transfer such information to the appropriate county veteran service agency.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "first responders assault prevention act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "first responders assault prevention act" which increases the offense classification for assault on a peace officer, police officer, firefighter or emergency medical services professional from a class C felony to a class B felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of artificial intelligence in customer services
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of the use of artificial intelligence in customer services at the point of interaction with the customer; defines terms.
sponsored.fis: None. This act shall take effect on the one hundred twentieth day after it shall have become law.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain requirements regarding the purchase and sale of a catalytic converter
sponsored.sum: Requires sellers of catalytic converters to provide certain information to potential buyers; requires buyers to maintain records of such purchases; makes any violations a class A misdemeanor; imposes a fine of up to $5,000

sponsored.t: Relates to residency restrictions for sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to establish residency restrictions for sex offenders.

sponsored.t: Relates to the public release of ballot images
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections to publicly release images of all ballots following an election.

sponsored.t: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers as hate crimes and makes graffiti a hate crime
sponsored.sum: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers as hate crimes; designates making graffiti as a specified offense.

sponsored.t: Directs the board to submit a recommendation regarding the central business district toll amounts to the legislature and recommending a privacy risk plan
sponsored.sum: Directs the board to submit a recommendation regarding the central business district toll amounts to the legislature and also to recommend a privacy risk plan.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of the novel coronavirus/COVID-19 immunization
sponsored.sum: Prohibits administrative agencies from administering or requiring the COVID-19 immunization unless authorized by the legislature.

sponsored.t: Requires a government photo identification card to be presented when casting a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires a government photo identification card to be presented when casting a ballot; provides for a method to receive a government photo identification card at no charge; provides that notaries are not permitted to collect a fee for collecting the documents required.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring Eagle Scouts
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring the Eagle Scouts for which the regular registration fee will apply plus an initial one time service charge of $25.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictions on authority for the withholding of public monies from educational institutions
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of education may also withhold from any district or city its share of the public money of the state for willfully disobeying any provision of law, or for such decisions, orders or regulations as aforesaid whose willful violation constitutes an immediate threat to the health, safety, education or welfare of students, employees or visitors at such common school, educational institution, school district or public school.

sponsored.t: Expands the offense of unlawfully dealing with a child in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Expands the offense of unlawfully dealing with a child in the second degree to include allowing a child less than eighteen years old to enter or remain in an establishment that serves alcohol and does not have an on-site kitchen.

sponsored.t: Relates to sentencing of person convicted of murdering a minor
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person convicted of murder in the first or second degree, or aggravated murder, in the death of a minor shall be sentenced to life imprisonment without parole.

sponsored.t: Relates to apprenticeship training
sponsored.sum: Requires that a minimum of ten percent of the labor hours of the total construction workforce employed by all contractors and subcontractors performing work pursuant to a construction contract shall be performed by a person or persons participating in a certified apprenticeship program; makes technical amendments.

sponsored.t: Relates to apprenticeship training
sponsored.sum: Requires such apprenticeship program is specific to the type and scope of work which is being performed and have a graduation rate of at least thirty percent as determined by the department of labor; makes technical corrections.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting certain claims for compensation based on a COVID-19 diagnosis
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting certain claims for compensation based on a COVID-19 diagnosis which were denied or not timely filed.

sponsored.t: Relates to transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district
sponsored.sum: Legalizes, validates, ratifies and confirms certain transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to the excelsior research and development tax credit
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "empire innovation act"; provides that a participant in the excelsior jobs program shall be eligible to claim a credit equal to the portion of the full cost of the participant's research and development expenses incurred that relates to the participant's research and development expenditures in New York state during the taxable year; provided however, if the participant receives a federal research and development tax credit calculated on the full cost of the participant's research and development expenses that relates to the participant's research and development expenditures in New York state during the taxable year, then said participant shall only be eligible to claim a credit…

sponsored.t: Provides that the list of pre-authoized procedures is to be used only as a list of treatment that does not require insurance carrier approval
sponsored.sum: Simplifies the procedure by which injured workers obtain treatment for injuries covered by the workers' compensation law; provides that the list of pre-authorized procedures is to be used only as a list of treatment that does not require insurance carrier approval.

sponsored.t: Relates to benefits of temporarily partially disabled workers
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that workers who are temporarily partially disabled are entitled to payment of benefits at a reduced rate unless their separation from employment is unrelated to the compensable injury.

sponsored.t: Permits payment of testing performed or medications obtained out of network at the negotiated network rate
sponsored.sum: Provides that a non-network pharmacy that provides causally related medications to a claimant shall be entitled to payment at the network rate negotiated between the carrier and the pharmacy network if the carrier's network provides mail order service or is located within a reasonable distance from the claimant; reduces costs of treatment by requiring out of network providers accept payment at the carrier's negotiated network rate, while at the same time allowing injured workers to obtain treatment in a timely manner by providing for payment to the provider when they do not obtain the treatment within the network; provides that any special diagnostic tests, x-ray examinations, magnetic…

sponsored.t: Relates to bail for certain felony offenses involving the manufacture, sale, distribution, or possession with intent to sell synthetic opioids
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of bail for certain felony offenses involving the manufacture, sale, distribution, or possession with intent to sell synthetic opioids.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing Nassau County auxiliary police to have police batons
sponsored.sum: Allows members of the Nassau County auxiliary police force to possess a police baton when authorized by the police commissioner of such county.
sponsored.fis: Minimal costs to state and local government

sponsored.t: Requires the development of a bleeding control kit program and the installation of bleeding control kits in schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education, in consultation with the commissioner of health, to develop a bleeding control kit program which requires bleeding control kits to be installed in easily accessible areas of schools; requires training of personnel to use bleeding control kits in the event of an injury to another person.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the commissioner from promulgating any rules or regulations which prevent schools from disallowing biological male students at birth to participate on a team organized for females
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the commissioner from promulgating any rules or regulations which prevent schools from disallowing biologically male students at birth to participate on a team organized for females where a school determines such biological male student's participation would have an adverse effect on the physical or emotional safety of female participants, or would adversely impact a female student's ability to participate successfully in interschool athletic competition.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "unique abilities employment act" relating to the employment of persons with developmental disabilities by school districts.

sponsored.t: Relates to recusal by a court of appeals judge
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a court of appeals judge recuses themselves from sitting in or taking part in the decision, action, claim, matter, motion or proceeding, a replacement shall be chosen on a rotating basis, based on seniority, of the next available appellate division judge.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Long Island transportation account
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Long Island transportation account within the New York city transportation assistance fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the passing of stopped school buses on divided highways and to the location of school bus stops on divided highways
sponsored.sum: Relates to the passing of stopped school buses on divided highways; provides that vehicles traveling in the opposite direction of a school bus on such highway shall not have to stop if a physical barrier is present between the different directions of travel.

sponsored.t: Relates to transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district
sponsored.sum: Legalizes, validates, ratifies and confirms certain transportation contracts of the Hicksville union free school district.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. This act shall take effect on the thirteenth day it shall have become a law.

sponsored.t: Requires all medical facilities to have immediate access to every single-occupancy bathroom where a patient could be in an emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires all medical facilities to have immediate access to every single-occupancy bathroom where a patient could be in an emergency.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Bethpage community park cleanup independent state monitorship
sponsored.sum: Establishes an independent state monitorship to oversee containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup of the groundwater plume associated with the Northrop Grumman Bethpage Facility and Naval Weapons Industrial Reserve Plant sites in the hamlet of Bethpage within the town of Oyster Bay and compliance by Northrop Grumman and any other parties responsible for such containment, remediation, excavation and cleanup with any operative consent decrees, consent judgments, settlements, or agreements.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "educator expense assistance act" to allow educators to deduct qualified expenses incurred by K-12 educators.

sponsored.t: Prohibits funding for certain SUNY, CUNY or community colleges or organizations on such campuses which, directly or indirectly, permit terrorist organizations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits funding for SUNY, CUNY or community colleges which, directly or indirectly, permit terrorist organizations on campus; provides that the state university trustees adopt rules and regulations that any student group or student organization that receives funding from the state university of New York that directly or indirectly promotes, encourages, advocates, or permits any terrorist advocacy or activities on campuses, shall be ineligible for funding, including funding from student activity fee proceeds.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of deceptive wearing of a mask and aggravated deceptive wearing of a mask
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of deceptive wearing of a mask and aggravated deceptive wearing of a mask; makes such crimes a class B misdemeanor and a class A misdemeanor, respectively.

sponsored.t: Relates to ADA or handicapped parking spaces at an arena
sponsored.sum: Requires all ADA or handicapped parking spaces at an arena, entertainment or sports venue shall be directly outside the entrance door to the building as stated in federal law; provides that failure to comply with the provisions of this section shall result in an automatic suspension of any New York liquor license held by such venue for a period of one week for each day in which such venue is noncompliant; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail
sponsored.sum: Establishes that making a terroristic threat is a qualifying offense for bail.

sponsored.t: Exempts vehicles owned and/or operated by certain persons, vendors, organizations or not-for-profit corporations from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts vehicles owned and/or operated by a not-for-profit corporation, any private vehicle operated by a worker or volunteer, first responders, military personnel, veterans, healthcare workers, critical infrastructure workers acting on behalf of such organization or public employees traveling in an official capacity, wholesale food distributors or wholesale or retail delivery vehicles from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

sponsored.t: Prohibits funding of any degree-granting institution of higher education if such institution permits certain organizations on campus
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state funding of any degree-granting institution of higher education if such institution permits terrorist organizations or activities in support of such organizations on campus; prohibits any student group or organization of receiving funding from the degree-granting institution if such group or organization directly or indirectly promotes, encourages, advocates, or engages in any terrorist advocacy or activities on campus.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor from preventing or inhibiting state agency cooperation with the federal government for the purposes of immigration enforcement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor from preventing or inhibiting state agency cooperation with the federal government for the purposes of immigration enforcement; prohibits state agencies from preventing or inhibiting collaboration with federal agencies for the purposes of federal immigration enforcement.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions of law relating to the disclosure of certain records
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions of law relating to the disclosure of immigration records by the department of motor vehicles which make it a class E felony to disclose such records and information pertaining to immigration status.

sponsored.t: Relates to businesses with fewer than twenty employees
sponsored.sum: Provides that any taxpayer who employees twenty or fewer employees, the first fifty thousand dollars is exempted from taxation.

sponsored.t: Relates to reciprocity between the state and counties for businesses that are certified as minority and women-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the director of the division of minority and women's business development and the county executive of counties to enter into a memorandum of understanding to allow reciprocity between the state and such county for businesses that are certified as minority and women-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Establishes the division of the crime victims' statewide advocate to represent crime victims' legal interests
sponsored.sum: Establishes the division of the crime victims' statewide advocate to represent crime victims' and witnesses' legal interests during discovery and trial and assist with victim compensation applications.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. This act shall take effect January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical treatment for certain workers' compensation claimants
sponsored.sum: Provides that where an employer or insurance carrier elects to controvert the right to compensation and such claimant holds a valid insurance policy, the employer or insurance carrier shall provide medical treatment to the injured claimant and payment to health care providers without regard to such controversy.

sponsored.t: Relates to county-wide shared services panels
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the South Nassau Water Authority and the North Shore Water Authority to remain eligible for funding in state fiscal year two thousand twenty-six--two thousand twenty-seven.

sponsored.t: Requires registering with the sex offender registry no later than five days after any change of address
sponsored.sum: Requires registering with the sex offender registry no later than five days after any change of address.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting school buses from certain regulations on the percentage of zero-emission vehicles in manufacturers' sales fleets
sponsored.sum: Exempts school buses from certain regulations relating to the percentage of zero-emission vehicles in manufacturer's sales fleets of medium-duty and heavy-duty vehicles.

sponsored.t: Establishes a battery storage fire training program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a battery storage fire training program under the purview of the state fire administrator.

sponsored.t: Relates to health insurance coverage for surviving dependents following the death of a police officer by suicide
sponsored.sum: Provides that where an active or retired police officer dies by suicide and is enrolled in a health insurance plan, the surviving dependents of such police officer shall be entitled to such health insurance coverage for ninety days following such police officer's death.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Fentanyl Fathers and Mothers Act
sponsored.sum: Requires the education department, in consultation with the department of health, to develop and adopt a comprehensive fentanyl education, awareness, and recognition program for all public, charter, and private schools in the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award for which the regular registration fee will apply plus an initial one time service charge of $25.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of transportation to study the regional fairness of state funding for local roadway paving purposes
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to study the regional fairness of state funding for local roadway paving purposes, including but not limited to the Consolidated Local Street and Highway Improvement Program (CHIPS), State Touring Routes program, PAVE-NY, Pave Our Potholes (POP), and other existing local roadway aid programs, and to make recommendations concerning the reinstatement of the suburban highway improvement program (SHIPS) funding program.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper James M. MacLarnon
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Nassau county to Trooper James M. MacLarnon.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage of certain procedures to detect breast cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage of sonograms and other diagnostic procedures used to detect breast cancer for covered persons with a prior history of breast cancer or who have a first degree relative with a prior history of breast cancer.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. 30 days after it shall have become law.
